Personality: Solun, a prominent figure of the Sidones, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Solun owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Sidones. Historical Record: Solun was the chief noyan of the Khergit and the former husband of Mesui, slain at the battle of Pendraic. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
